implemented.name: taskflow.http.requests
implemented.meaning: Completed or aborted HTTP pipeline requests; status 0 denotes cancellation or unknown status.

implemented.name: taskflow.http.errors
implemented.meaning: 4xx client_error, 5xx server_error, or cancelled. Report 5xx separately from expected 4xx.

implemented.name: taskflow.http.request.duration
implemented.meaning: Elapsed application pipeline duration, including failures; not browser/render or full network latency.

implemented.name: taskflow.database.readiness.checks
implemented.meaning: Executed readiness checks, with finite safe result codes.

implemented.name: taskflow.database.readiness.duration
implemented.meaning: Elapsed readiness probe duration, including failed/cancelled probes.

implemented.name: taskflow.database.readiness
implemented.meaning: Last completed probe: -1 unknown, 0 not ready, 1 ready. Cancellation leaves the previous completed state intact.

implemented.name: taskflow.database.readiness.age
implemented.meaning: Age of last completed probe; -1 before any completion. Not a continuous database health assertion.

implemented.name: taskflow.security.signals
implemented.meaning: Bounded operational outcomes; no actor identity, incident verdict or durable audit guarantees.

securityVocabulary.scope: Observed HTTP outcomes only. Full attributed security event envelope and restricted storage remain SaaS-013.

reservedWorkerMetrics.name: taskflow.worker.ready
reservedWorkerMetrics.meaning: -1 unknown, 0 not processing, 1 processing; producer/lease health defined in SaaS-017.

reservedWorkerMetrics.name: taskflow.worker.outbox.pending
reservedWorkerMetrics.meaning: Committed undelivered eligible outbox records, excluding terminal rows; no per-workspace dimension.

reservedWorkerMetrics.name: taskflow.worker.outbox.oldest.age
reservedWorkerMetrics.meaning: Age of oldest eligible pending record. Distinguish no backlog from unavailable measurement.

reservedWorkerMetrics.name: taskflow.worker.delivery.attempts
reservedWorkerMetrics.meaning: Bounded channel/outcome values; retries are attempts, not unique notifications.

reservedWorkerMetrics.name: taskflow.worker.outbox.dead_letter
reservedWorkerMetrics.meaning: Unresolved terminal records requiring operator review; replay remains audited.
